answer.reason: JDG 3:31 states what Shamgar did: he slew six hundred Philistines with an ox goad and delivered Israel.

clauses.english: slew six hundred Philistines with an ox goad
clauses.quote: slew of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox goad

doubts: JDG 5:6 only dates a time of empty highways to his days, so it was left out.
His delivering Israel was folded into the single deed rather than given a separate clause.
